implementation.removedRepeatedWork: Avoid allocating and initializing fresh zeroed filtered-resize output when all samples are overwritten. Use the existing complete-overwrite allocator already used by Lanczos/nearest/clone, keeping acquisition/ownership/disposal timed.
implementation.endState: One output-admission/ownership policy across complete-overwrite transforms. No new API, cache, pool, scope, numerical abstraction or pixel-loop change.
implementation.memory: Unbudgeted exact-size buffers may use the unchanged4MiB/two-idle-array pool. Shared-budget outputs reserve actual capacity before fresh uninitialized allocation and never use that pool. Retained outputs remain individually charged until disposal.
implementation.numeric: Every kernel, tap/candidate order, clamped edge, Q30/rational/certified rounding and repair remains unchanged. No native tolerance or codec packet change.

decision.basis: Simpler common ownership policy, material confirmed large byte-enlargement CPU/allocation savings, smaller word gain, unchanged governed peaks and exact full outputs. Wide reduction retains passing parity despite adverse raw point; do not retune the passing case.
